# Ecommerce Playbook for AI

> Technical version of the Ecommerce Playbook, written for AI assistants and power users: every number, setting, threshold and step, with unit identifiers in brackets such as [L0012.003]. Sources are named Source A to F. Older advice is marked with its year.

- [Whole playbook, one file](https://lichtersapps.com/aiecom/ecommerce-playbook.md)
